# acm

Advanced Cluster Management hub: MultiClusterHub, observability and search

Stability: stable ([Compatibility](https://policystk.io/reference/compatibility/#element-stability))

```yaml
stack:
  acm:
    enabled: true
```

## Optional pieces

Shipped with `enabled: false`. Turn one on in a values layer.

| Entry | Description | Turn on with |
|---|---|---|
| Policy [`addons`](#policy-addons) | Policy addon tuning | `policies.addons.enabled: true` |
| Policy [`observability`](#policy-observability) | Long-term metric storage | `policies.observability.enabled: true` |
| template `observability-metrics` (needs Policy `observability`) | Custom metrics allowlist | `policies.observability.templates.metrics.enabled: true` |
| Policy [`search`](#policy-search) | ACM Search persistent storage | `policies.search.enabled: true` |

## Settings

Under `stack.acm.config`. Maps merge across layers; lists are replaced whole.

| Key | Description | Default |
|---|---|---|
| `availabilityConfig` | High or Basic. Basic runs single replicas and suits lab hubs. | `High` |
| `selfManaged` | Whether the hub also manages itself as `local-cluster` | `true` |
| `search` | ACM Search database storage |  |
| `search.size` |  | `100Gi` |
| `search.storageClass` | Empty uses the cluster default. The field is then omitted, since an empty string disables provisioning. | `''` |
| `observability` | Observability sizing |  |
| `observability.namespace` | Namespace for MultiClusterObservability and its bucket | `open-cluster-management-observability` |
| `observability.bucket` | ObjectBucketClaim name. Its ConfigMap and Secret carry the Thanos bucket credentials. | `acm-observability` |
| `observability.enableMetrics` |  | `true` |
| `observability.interval` |  | `300` |
| `observability.storageClass` |  | `gp3-csi` |
| `observability.bucketStorageClass` |  | `openshift-storage.noobaa.io` |
| `observability.alertmanagerStorageSize` |  | `1Gi` |
| `observability.compactStorageSize` |  | `100Gi` |
| `observability.receiveStorageSize` |  | `100Gi` |
| `observability.ruleStorageSize` |  | `1Gi` |
| `observability.storeStorageSize` |  | `10Gi` |
| `observability.s3` | External S3-compatible storage (AWS S3, MinIO, Ceph RGW) in place of the NooBaa bucket. Setting bucket turns it on and drops the ObjectBucketClaim. To stop waiting for ODF, also set policies.observability.dependencies to [{name: hub}] in the same layer. Switching a hub from NooBaa leaves the ObjectBucketClaim and the metrics in it: delete it by hand. |  |
| `observability.s3.bucket` | Bucket name, 3-63 characters. Empty uses the NooBaa bucket. | `''` |
| `observability.s3.endpoint` | host[:port], no scheme or path, for example s3.us-east-1.amazonaws.com or minio.example.com:9000 | `''` |
| `observability.s3.region` | Empty lets the client ask the bucket. Set it for AWS when the IAM policy denies s3:GetBucketLocation. | `''` |
| `observability.s3.insecure` | Plain HTTP instead of HTTPS. This does not skip certificate checks: use caSecret for a private CA. | `false` |
| `observability.s3.credentialsSecret` | Secret in the observability namespace holding AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID and AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY. Required with bucket. | `''` |
| `observability.s3.caSecret` | Secret in the observability namespace whose ca.crt verifies the endpoint. It replaces the system roots, so it must hold the whole chain. Empty trusts the public CAs. Clearing it or bucket later leaves tlsSecretName on the MultiClusterObservability: remove that by hand. | `''` |
| `observability.customMetrics` | Metrics collected on top of the default allowlist, written by template metrics. |  |
| `observability.customMetrics.names` | Metric names | `[]` |
| `observability.customMetrics.recordingRules` | Entries {record, expr}: expr is a PromQL query run on each managed cluster at every collection interval, and its result is sent to the hub as the metric named by record. | `[]` |
| `addons` | Policy addon tuning, keyed by addon name. The shipped defaults raise the stock concurrency and rate limits, which are the usual bottleneck at scale. | 2 entries, below |

<details><summary><code>addons</code> default</summary>

```yaml
config-policy-controller:
  evaluationConcurrency: 5
  clientQPS: 75
  clientBurst: 100
  requests:
    cpu: 150m
    memory: 256Mi
  limits:
    memory: 1Gi
governance-policy-framework:
  evaluationConcurrency: 5
  clientQPS: 75
  clientBurst: 100
  requests:
    cpu: 100m
    memory: 128Mi
  limits:
    memory: 512Mi
```

</details>

## Operators

Each renders into Policy `install` with `<name>-ns` and `<name>-status`. Pin with `operatorPolicies.<key>.versions` in a layer.

| Operator policy | Package | Channel | Source | Namespace | Versions |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|

## Policies

`<cluster>` is the ManagedCluster name, or hubName on the hub. `global.remediationAction: inform` overrides every action below.

Standards: NIST SP 800-53. Controls: CM-2 Baseline Configuration. Categories: CM Configuration Management.

### Policy `addons`

`addons-acm-<cluster>`: Policy addon tuning. Depends on `hub-acm-<cluster>`. Off by default; turn on with `policies.addons.enabled: true`.

| Template | Action | Severity | Renders | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `addons-addon-tuning` | enforce | medium | [addon-tuning](converters/addons/addon-tuning.yaml) | Policy addon concurrency and resources |

### Policy `hub`

`hub-acm-<cluster>`: Deploy the MultiClusterHub. Depends on `install-acm-<cluster>`.

| Template | Action | Severity | Waits for | Renders | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `hub-mch` | enforce | high | `install-acm-status`<br>compliant while pending | [mch](converters/hub/mch.yaml) | MultiClusterHub |

### Policy `install`

`install-acm-<cluster>`: Install and manage the ACM operator.

| Template | Action | Severity | Renders | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `install-acm` | enforce | medium | [operator](#operators) `advanced-cluster-management` | Advanced Cluster Management operator |

### Policy `observability`

`observability-acm-<cluster>`: Long-term metric storage. Depends on `hub-acm-<cluster>`, `ready-odf-<cluster>`. Off by default; turn on with `policies.observability.enabled: true`.

| Template | Action | Severity | Waits for | Renders | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `observability-bucket` | enforce | medium |  | [bucket](converters/observability/bucket.yaml) | Observability namespace and Thanos bucket |
| `observability-mco` | enforce | medium | `observability-bucket`<br>compliant while pending | [mco](converters/observability/mco.yaml) | MultiClusterObservability and its object storage config |
| `observability-metrics` (off) | enforce | medium | `observability-bucket` | [metrics](converters/observability/metrics.yaml) (mustonlyhave) | Custom metrics allowlist |

### Policy `search`

`search-acm-<cluster>`: ACM Search persistent storage. Depends on `hub-acm-<cluster>`. Off by default; turn on with `policies.search.enabled: true`.

| Template | Action | Severity | Renders | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `search-search-storage` | enforce | medium | [search-storage](converters/search/search-storage.yaml) | Search database storage |
